out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed staff use the the handsink by the kitchen door being as a dump sink
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO ONLY USE HAND SINK FOR HAND WASHING. STAFF MOVED WATER PITCHERS TO THE DISH PIT.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: No paper towels were observed at the hand sink at the main bar
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. STAFF PLACED A ROLL OF PAPER TOWELS BY THIS HAND SINK. ALWAYS PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS AT ALL HAND SINKS TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served or sold in a ready-to-eat form without freezing for parasite destruction is not properly identified as such: 1) salmon
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form and the fish is raised and fed as specified by Law, a written agreement or statement from the supplier or aquaculturist stipulating that the fish were raised and fed shall be obtained by the person in charge and retained in the records for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. PROVIDE EHS DOCUMENTATION THAT THE SALMON IS FARM-RASIED AND PELLET FED. CONTACT YOUR SALMON PROVIDER FOR THIS INFORMATION/PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: 1) in the main walk-in cooler: Raw ground beef patties were observed being stored above Raw beef and Raw liver
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CHEF INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REORGANIZE THE SPEED RACK. RAW GROUND BEEF PATTIES WERE OBSERVED UNDER THE RAW BEEF AND LIVER.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: A hotel pan and other food storage containers were observed be passed through the high temperature dish machine. High temperature dish machine was observed at 149F using PIC’s high temperature dish plate
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. AFTER SEVERAL CYCLES, HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE WAS LATER OBSERVED AT 160F. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC AND MANAGEMENT TO ENSURE THE DISH MACHINE REACHES 160F BEFORE USING THE MACHINE TO CLEAN AND SANITIZE DISHES.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) in the walk-in cooler, two pans of confited duck was observed date marked for more than 7 days
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE DUCK.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed buckets of cleaning products being stored next to a bottle of oil and a bucket of snail shells under the oven
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC MOVED THE CLEANING PRODUCTS TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) door of the 2DWR, 1DR scallopini cooler was observed with large holes on the interior exposing the foam insulation
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. REPAIR OR REPLACE DOOR. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: 1) in the 2DWR, 1DR sauté cooler, the empty sheet trays were observed with accumulated food debris. 2) accumulated food debris was observed under the motor mechanism of a large stand mix Facility has been closed for the past 2 days.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. STAFF REMOVED OLD SHEET TRAYS AND PLACED THEM IN THE DISH PIT. L'AUBERGE CHEZ FRANCOIS (Inspection Date: 11/04/2026) Page 3 of 4
